observations:
Torah #12 yields 4 packages that map cleanly onto the Torah's structural argument. No new independent bechina-cluster exists that falls outside these four packages.

The teaching's structure (eitza flow between packages):
  Package 2 (Oral Torah/Shekhinah — the fallen Shekhinah in exile)
    → eitza → Package 1 (Neshikin — the holy kiss that begins the ascent)
    → eitza → Package 3 (Embrace/Right — the loving embrace of the tzaddik who accepts humiliation)
    → eitza → Package 2 (Oral Torah — returned to its source, rebuilt through wisdom)
  Package 4 (Two Tzaddikim — the structural frame within which the Shekhinah dwells)
    → overarches all, is the context for Packages 1–3

Good/evil mirror note: Torah #12 has a fully developed evil mirror (לבן / תלמיד חכם שד יהודי / הורמיז בר לילתא / גלות השכינה / נשיקות שונא) but it is represented ONLY in eitza edges in the current dataset — there are ZERO bechina edges for the evil cluster in reference=12. This means the evil counterpart cannot form a package from existing data. The absence is a data gap (see torah_12_additions.json), not a structural decision. If the recommended additions are implemented (primarily: לבן ↔ תלמיד חכם שד יהודי ref=12), a fifth evil package would become warranted:
  Proposed Package 5 (if additions implemented): לָבָן וְהַשֵּׁד — The False Scholar
  Polarity: evil
  Core: לבן = תלמיד חכם שד יהודי = הורמיז בר לילתא = bar Lilit
  Mirrors: Package 2 (Oral Torah in holiness) → evil version: Oral Torah in exile within the false scholar
  Mirrors: Package 4 (two tzaddikim) → evil version: the false scholar who wrongly thinks the Tanna is his 'brother in deceit'

The three-stage ascent (חיבוק → נשיקין → זיווג) is a noteworthy structural feature: the Torah explicitly names three ascending levels of the Shekhinah's return. The current 4 packages map onto this: Package 3 = חיבוק, Package 1 = נשיקין, and זיווג is the implicit culmination (described in text but not yet represented in a fourth bechina cluster — the זיווג section discusses חכמה as the enabler but mainly through eitza relationships). No new package is warranted for זיווג from existing bechina edges.

Conclusion: 4 packages are correct and complete for the existing dataset. Implementation of the evil-cluster additions in torah_12_additions.json would raise the package count to 5.
